source_scan_review.note: PDF-page numbers are convenience locators to the supplied scan. Canonical source identity remains source_id plus printed-page anchor plus source-record path. Exact source wording remains in canonical rows; no long quotation is duplicated.

requirements: source span verified and review status SOURCE_SPAN_VERIFIED or HUMAN_VERIFIED
normalization is explicitly verified and non-hypothetical
explicit natal condition atoms or required_natal_rule_ids are required
an explicit positive temporal condition is required
all temporal condition atoms must use the selected reaction layer
unbound star-presence and mutagen facts must not be joined by inference
current_compiler_contract.star_bound_transformation_behavior: The adapter emits a star-bound TRANSFORMATION_PRESENT only when the PL1 temporal star object itself carries mutagen and its palace_name is grounded. It never joins a scope-level mutagen to an unbound star.

gap_register.summary: A temporal row points to a preceding/context row that is case-only, unresolved, or not a canonical executable natal antecedent. Preserve the reference; do not promote or flatten the parent. C9 #945 adds CA09-851 as a referenced Pojun-career-context item whose completeness requires separate validation; source row remains unchanged.

gap_register.family: Source time-scope wider than single reaction layer
gap_register.summary: The source explicitly covers more than one time layer or combines YEAR with 小限, while the current reaction contract binds one selected layer. Do not drop, duplicate, or silently prioritize a layer.
Source terms such as 煞忌冲起, 流煞冲会, or compound activation do not map to an approved exact typed relation in the current fact contract.
Separate star presence and scope-level mutagen facts cannot be joined. Where the source does not identify a temporal palace, do not invent one to satisfy the runtime fact shape.
The source condition does not uniquely identify a required star/group or typed compound convergence; preserve all conjunctions and ambiguity rather than simplify to a trigger.

gap_register.family: Undefined generic groups or favorable/supportive period
gap_register.summary: Generic 吉曜/煞曜/吉化, severity, and favorable/unfavorable/supportive-period phrases are not executable atoms without a source-backed closed definition. No score may be inferred from outcomes. C9 #945 adds CA09-851's 良好流年 phrase as a Career-scoped PERIOD_VALENCE_OR_SUPPORT overlap; no GOOD_YEAR predicate is created.

The source expresses two non-interchangeable path forms: CA09-851 multi-year consecutive annual condition; TP03-248 same-year antecedent branch with event-consequence path. Literal duration is evidence only, not a universal threshold or clock.
A source token is explicitly uncertain. Keep the row fail-closed until the owning palace performs source adjudication.

gap_register.family: Brightness predicate unavailable in temporal facts
gap_register.summary: 入庙/落陷 is part of the source condition but is not currently exposed as an approved temporal condition fact.

gap_register.family: Pure temporal source clause has no independent natal antecedent
gap_register.summary: The source clause is an annual temporal trigger, but the current compiler requires an explicit natal condition or required natal rule ID. A vacuous PALACE_PRESENT gate would be fabricated semantics.

gap_register.family: Negation is not closed-world over generic groups
gap_register.summary: 不见吉曜/不见煞 cannot be inferred from absence in the currently observed fact set; no closed-world group negation is approved.

gap_register.family: Service-institution context is not a typed fact
gap_register.summary: The source projection depends on a service-institution context; it is not a standalone temporal trigger and is not represented as a typed fact.
CASE_SUPPORT_ONLY and EVENT_CANDIDATE evidence can support discussion but cannot become reusable executable temporal reaction rules.

CA04-350's capital-shortage interpretation is conditioned on commerce, but CA04-348 is a real-world context gate rather than a natal fact and no typed commerce/context fact is available to this PL3-T reaction contract. Do not substitute CA04-349's technical-skill scene or infer commerce from the outcome.
gap_register.family: Real-world commerce context is not a typed state/context fact

human_gate_candidates.trigger: Only if proposing a new shared executable predicate for 煞忌冲起 / 流煞冲会 / activation geometry.
Only if defining universal executable 吉曜/煞曜/吉化 groups or favorable/unfavorable/supportive-period predicates.
Only if adding a multi-year persistence gate, independent clock, duration threshold, or temporal memory.
Only if supporting one reaction that combines or prioritizes multiple source time layers, including YEAR+小限.
Only if adding 入庙/落陷 as an approved temporal condition fact.
Only if defining closed-world negation over generic star groups.
